Recall it: Write the route through the heart from the right atrium to the aorta.

Check your answers

Show chamber names, blood-flow route, and valves

Chambers: 1 right atrium · 2 right ventricle · 3 left atrium · 4 left ventricle.

Route: right atrium → tricuspid valve → right ventricle → pulmonary valve → lungs → pulmonary veins → left atrium → mitral valve → left ventricle → aortic valve → body.

Valves: tricuspid, pulmonary semilunar, mitral (bicuspid), aortic semilunar.
